name: Reflexive thematic analysis
summary: Braun and Clarke's six phases. Codes stay close to the data and may change as you read; themes are patterns of shared meaning that you construct. The method does not rely on coder agreement.
notes: Agreement between coders is hidden by default because reflexive thematic analysis does not treat coding as something to be reproduced. It is still available if your design needs it.
AI coding starts switched off. Turn it on only if you can explain in your write-up how it fits a reflexive approach.

phases.title: Familiarization with the data
phases.goal: Read and re-read the material, noting first impressions without coding yet.
memo_prompts: What stands out to you, and why might it stand out to you in particular?
What assumptions are you bringing to this material?
exit_checklist: Read every source at least once
Wrote a familiarization note for each source
Wrote a reflexive journal entry about your starting assumptions

phases.title: Initial coding
phases.goal: Code anything that seems interesting about the data, keeping codes close to the participants' words.
memo_prompts: How is your own position shaping what you code?
Which codes are you unsure about, and what would help you decide?
exit_checklist: Gave each settled code a short definition
Wrote a reflexive memo about how your position shapes your coding

phases.title: Constructing themes
phases.goal: Group codes into candidate themes: patterns of shared meaning organised around a central idea.
memo_prompts: What is the central idea that holds this candidate theme together?
Which codes did not fit anywhere, and what might that tell you?
exit_checklist: Drafted candidate themes on the canvas
Gathered the coded extracts for each candidate theme
Wrote a memo on why you grouped codes this way

phases.title: Reviewing themes
phases.goal: Check the candidate themes against the coded extracts and against the whole dataset.
memo_prompts: Does each theme tell a coherent story? Where does it break down?
What does the dataset say that no theme captures?
exit_checklist: Checked each theme against its coded extracts
Checked the themes against the whole dataset
Merged, split, or dropped themes where needed

phases.title: Defining and naming themes
phases.goal: Say what each theme is about, how it fits the larger story, and give it a name that carries its meaning.
memo_prompts: In a few sentences, what is this theme, and what is it not?
exit_checklist: Wrote a definition for every theme
Chose a name for every theme
Chose vivid extracts for every theme

phases.title: Writing up
phases.goal: Weave the analysis and the extracts into a report that tells the story.
memo_prompts: What would a reader need to know about you to judge this analysis?
exit_checklist: Drafted the methods section from the record
